purpose: Explicit gap taxonomy (criteria → subcriteria → row coverage) after quality remediation — repo-accounted evidence, not blanket product closure.

subcriteria.text: Server authoritative round types match client for online games
subcriteria.openWork: Implement non-prompt server rounds + tests; use existing REQ0017 — no duplicate tracker item.

criteria.title: Release / Play / signing / privacy (org account state)

subcriteria.openWork: Parent confirms GitHub secrets + Play internal track state — audit does not verify org vault.
Reconcile tracker with user-reported internal draft — not observable in repo.

subcriteria.text: Privacy policy URL and in-app links
subcriteria.openWork: Confirm Console Data safety URL matches deployed site.

Close as N/A if Gradle-only; else add eas.json + policy.

criteria.title: Physical device & subjective UX (S24 cluster, audio sync, install proof)

subcriteria.text: Safe area / clipped UI / layout (DFCT0028-0034 cluster)
subcriteria.openWork: Device QA — irreducible in Linux CI.

subcriteria.text: UK English and Two Truths editorial (ENHC0017/0018)
subcriteria.openWork: Editorial checklist — no automated linguistic proof.
Close or rewrite to LiveKit — implementation refs prove no Grill mode in routing.

evidenceVerifiedAutomated.meaning: Automated tests directly support closure claim (rate limits / CI job / prompt copy / font script).

evidenceHighButNotVerified.meaning: Strong repo anchors and/or high-confidence notes — still not independent review or full device/visual proof.

notDemonstrablyCompleteInRepo.meaning: Tracker snapshot.done true but evidence classification is partial, code_proven_partial (medium), blocked_device_external, deferred, account_status_unknown, stale_tracker_mismatch, or missing — see traceability-FULL.json per row.
